title: Marriott Boundless Credit Limit: What You Can Know Before Applying
caption:
What credit limit will Marriott Bonvoy Boundless give you? Chase assigns your individual limit—we can’t promise a number before approval.

We couldn’t verify a Boundless-specific minimum in the official material reviewed; the linked Pricing & Terms disclosure was unavailable. That doesn’t mean no minimum exists.

Your limit is borrowing capacity. Available credit is the unused portion. Neither tells you what you can afford to repay in full, and a welcome-offer spending requirement doesn’t guarantee a matching limit.

Before applying, consider your realistic hotel use and review Chase’s current offer and linked Pricing & Terms: https://creditcards.chase.com/travel-credit-cards/marriott-bonvoy/boundless

Skip applying just to discover a limit. Set your travel budget around what you can repay in full.

Our explanation and hypothetical example: https://practicalrewards.com/blog/marriott-boundless-credit-limit-what-you-can-know-before-applying-7d2f40.html
